instruction: A minimalist studio portrait photograph captured in a close-up shot against a plain beige background. On the left, the blonde woman (R1) wearing a lavender fuzzy sweater and white graphic eyeliner looks directly forward with a neutral expression, resting her chin on her hand which is placed on the shoulder of the woman next to her. On the right, the curly-haired woman (R3) in a matching lavender fuzzy sweater and white graphic eyeliner stands close, looking ahead with a calm expression. The blonde woman (R1) leans her head against the curly-haired woman (R3) in a gentle, shoulder-to-shoulder pose. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates their faces, highlighting the cool pastel tones of their sweaters.

R1 leans her head against R3
R3 receives R1's shoulder and head contact while standing close
R1 and R3 stand in a gentle shoulder-to-shoulder pose
